text: Open a project from a Git URL: shallow clone into a local cache, open it read-only
description: On the project selection screen, accept a Git URL (https or ssh, any host). The backend shallow-clones it (git clone --depth 1) into a per-user cache directory keyed by host/owner/repo, refreshes with a fetch on reopen, and opens the contained .bowman read-only. No API tokens, no GitHub-specific API. Handle: repo without .bowman (clear message), large repos (depth 1, no checkout of unrelated files if feasible), private repos (fails gracefully unless the user's own git credentials allow it).
